title: Alistigo Node Standard
description: Pure CALM Standard defining alistigo-specific node properties. Composed with the CALM core node schema via allOf in patterns that reference it. Custom node-type values (module, skill, system) are documented in $defs — CALM's node-type field accepts any string.

ddd-layer.description: The DDD architectural layer this node belongs to. Required on module and system nodes.

core-npm-package.description: The primary npm package that implements this node (e.g. @alistigo/core-document). Required on module and system nodes except the Domain module, which is a pure DDD domain with no framework dependency.

default-plugin-package.description: The default npm package that ships the built-in implementation of this plugin (e.g. @alistigo/local-storage-plugin). Optional on plugin nodes. Consumers may substitute their own implementation via the plugin bus.

node-type-module.title: module
node-type-module.description: A cohesive unit of functionality with a clearly defined boundary and at least one public interface. Implemented by one or more npm packages. A module enforces encapsulation: consumers interact only through its declared interfaces. Examples: domain, document, ui, storage, logger. Expected standard properties: ddd-layer (required), core-npm-package (required except Domain).

node-type-skill.title: skill
node-type-skill.description: An AI agent capability definition node. A skill has no runtime code dependencies — it is a documentation and metadata asset (SKILL.md + optional JSON schema) that describes how an AI agent should generate, configure, and interact with an artifact. Published as an npm package and loaded on demand by AI chat interfaces and agent runtimes. ddd-layer and core-npm-package do not apply to this node type.

node-type-system.title: system
node-type-system.description: A deployable or composable system that wires together multiple modules. In alistigo's context this is typically the Artifact node — the composition root that assembles domain, document, UI, and the Plugin Bus, then loads plugins at startup. Expected standard properties: ddd-layer (optional), core-npm-package (optional).

node-type-plugin.title: plugin
node-type-plugin.description: A self-contained extension that registers with the Plugin Bus at artifact startup. Implements the plugin contract defined by the Plugin Bus. Decoupled from the Application node — loaded via the bus rather than wired in directly. Examples: storage, logger. ddd-layer (optional, typically Infrastructure), core-npm-package (optional).

node-type-group.title: group
node-type-group.description: Pure visual grouping container. Groups related nodes together into a named boundary region in archify diagrams without adding any runtime or structural semantics. Has no runtime package of its own. No standard properties (ddd-layer, core-npm-package) apply.
